description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named ClaimAttachmentSearchFilterParams, which extends the FilterParams class. It includes a property for a request ID and methods to get and set this request ID, used for filtering search parameters related to claim attachments within the HRM system.

classes.name: ClaimAttachmentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for specifying search filter parameters related to claim attachments, including a request ID filter.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the current request ID used as a filter parameter.

methods.name: setRequestId
methods.description: Sets the request ID to be used as a filter parameter.
